title: CalculationProcedureVersion - Data API
description: Defines a version of an Expression Set. The label for this object is Expression Set Version. This object is available in API version 53.0 and later.

CalculationProcedureId.description: The ID of the Expression Set to which this version belongs. This is a relationship field.

Constants.description: A serialized JSON object containing information about each constant. This information includes the name, data type, alias, and precision.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Description.description: A text description of the Expression Set Version.

EndDateTime.description: The last date on which this Expression Set Version is active.

IsEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsEnabled.description: Specifies whether this Expression Set Version is active. The default value is false.

IsLoopingEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsLoopingEnabled.description: Specifies whether looping is enabled in this Expression Set Version. The default value is false.

LastSimulatedVariablesInput.description: The input variables and results of the most recent simulation.

LoopEnd.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LoopEnd.description: The name of the end variable for looping.

LoopIncrement.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LoopIncrement.description: The name of the interval variable for looping.

LoopStart.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LoopStart.description: The name of the start variable for looping.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

Rank.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Rank.description: When more than one enabled version matches an Expression Set call, and the StartDateTime to EndDateTime spans overlap, the version with the highest Rank is chosen.

StartDateTime.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort, Update
StartDateTime.description: The first date on which this Expression Set Version is active.

VersionNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

special_access_rules: Access to Expression Sets requires OmniStudio licenses.
